about_the_game:
After the nuclear catastrophe, your bunker became the last safe haven. Each day brings a struggle for resources, defense against enemies, and exploration of a world where every new area holds fresh dangers. Collect antenna parts to send a distress signal - but remember, when night falls, the world turns lethally dangerous.

The Beginning

The first 60 seconds determine your survival chances. Grab everything valuable - canned food, meds, tools. But remember: when the timer runs out, a nuclear strike will hit the surface. Those left outside will perish in radioactive ash.

The Bunker

  • Expand your bunker by creating new rooms and spaces.

  • Build generators (gas/solar/wind) and wire them to power your equipment.

  • Defend your base with mutated plants that will protect your shelter.

Exploration

  • Players leave the bunker by day to search for resources and antenna parts in procedurally generated locations (nuclear shelters, swamps, villages, towns).

  • Each location features unique enemies.

  • At nightfall, characters begin losing sanity - you must return to the bunker before dark.

Your Goal

  • Collect all antenna parts from defeated bosses to prepare for final evacuation.
